whoItsFor: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers who want to evaluate or deploy an open-weight frontier multimodal model with long context and agentic coding capabilities. The README describes a very large MoE model, so this is aimed at teams with substantial inference infrastructure.
useCases: Long-horizon agentic coding across large repositories with terminal tool orchestration
Deep research and knowledge work producing interactive visualizations, dashboards, and documents
Multimodal reasoning over text, images, and video with a 1M-token context window
